items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: I watch Percy's playing. He fingers his instrument extremely legitimate.

ctx.x: This is rail 3 of Charlie DeVore. July 4, 1962 it is.

Yeah, well I want to just talk a little bit about the individual instruction from the New Orleans guys. Now, we had a session Sunday afternoon, which is the 1st of July, and we played a tune called Climax Rag, which is quite popular with Percy and George Lewis's band played a little bit. And Jim likes that tune a lot, and after when we got through... Howard too. Oh yeah, Howard plays it great. He plays all his own stuff in there. But afterwards Jim came up to me and said, hey I heard it. You know how Jim stutters…
